_doc: Mail backend per mailbox. 'gmail_api' (service account + domain-wide delegation) is allowed only for gmail_api_domains and is their default; every other mailbox defaults to 'app_password' (the SMTP/IMAP path, XOAUTH2 for Microsoft). Set a mailbox's backend here to switch it, e.g. {"backend": "app_password"} (needs its app password in SENDER_ACCOUNTS). failover: true lets a mailbox that fails sign-in retry once on its other backend; off by default. See Mail_Sender/GMAIL_API.md.
